cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small. You and I can get noodles. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small? She invited the whole choir.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. She's choosing people she sees every week. It isn't a verdict on your friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse together every Tuesday. Read me her message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. That's the kindest accurate sentence. Come have one with me.

mechanism: A organizes a consoling dinner and adjusts the offer while presenting progressively edited explanations of a friend exclusion instead of the full message.
confusable: Unlike a blanket cheerful lie with no response, A modifies the explanation after each contradiction and offers space for B feelings; authority depends on B accepting the alternative company.
comparison: Social exclusion and a message request differ from critical feedback about a portrait.
seedUse: D135-b Nina dinner, choir contradictions and uncomplicated evening; S02-b adjusts the company offer to keep B engaged without revealing full harshness.
